name: Geregu Power PLC
source: CRON 20261013: Unaudited results for the six months ended 30 June 2026: revenue N18.66 billion (H1 2025: N87.63 billion), after a planned maintenance overhaul of the gas turbines; cost of sales N11.73 billion; gross profit N6.93 billion; operating profit N8.48 billion, cushioned by an impairment reversal on financial assets; net finance income N4.92 billion; profit before tax N3.56 billion; income tax N1.06 billion; profit after tax N2.50 billion; basic earnings per share N1.00. Figures as printed to the nearest N10 million. || AfricanFinancials / StockAnalysis (audited)

rows.label: Revenue
rows.source: Geregu Power Plc unaudited interim financial statements for the period ended 30 June 2026 (NGX filing library), statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, comparative column for the year ended 31 December 2025, NGN thousands. Cost of sales 110,726,883 and gross profit 74,208,920 are printed lines; operating profit 48,149,444 is a printed line; net finance cost 6,164,411 is a printed line. The filed column ties: 184,935,803 less 110,726,883 equals 74,208,920; 74,208,920 plus other income 1,804,896 less the two printed expense lines 10,046,707 and 17,817,665 equals 48,149,444; 48,149,444 less 6,164,411 equals 41,985,033; 41,985,033 less income tax 14,734,530 equals 27,250,503. Revenue and Net Profit restated to the printed figures; the earlier values 184,936,000,000 and 27,251,000,000 were the same numbers rounded to the nearest NGN million.
